notes.title: The Heretics Playtest 0.0.0.6 Patch Note 2025.05.18
notes.content:
[h3][b]New Hell-Themed Maps[/b][/h3]
Seven new Hell-stage maps have been added.

[h3][b]Waves 1–3:[/b][/h3]
These maps are themed around escaping the dungeon where you've been imprisoned.
You can strategically use spike traps to eliminate enemies, and breakable objects such as crates and barrels now grant additional resources when destroyed.

[h3][b]Waves 4–7:[/b][/h3]
Having escaped the dungeon, you must now travel through the fiery caves of Hell on your way to the Mortal Land.
In these caves, lava bursts occasionally create flame zones, which inflict the burning status on both the player and enemies. These hazards can also be used to your advantage with proper positioning.

[h3][b]Ongoing Work on Map Interactions[/b][/h3]
Map interactions for Waves 4–6 are still in development.

One notable addition is in The Cave of Wrath, where you can now interact with the Skull of Wrath.
Activating it will summon additional, stronger enemies not normally found in the Hell stages.
It’s up to you to decide: take the risk for more action, or play it safe?

More maps, interactive elements, environmental traps, and boss monsters at the end of each Wave 7 are planned for future updates.

Thank you for playing The Heretics.

notes.title: The Heretics Playtest 0.0.0.5 Patch Note 2025.04.30
notes.content:
Patch Notes

1. Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where item swapping didn't work properly, causing the dragged item to overwrite the target item.

- Fixed a bug where the Warrior's ESword magnet range effect stacked unintentionally.

- Fixed a bug where the item description panel would not close after selling an item.

2. Balance Changes

- Increased default item pickup range.

- Added limits to Skill Haste and Movement Speed.

- Nerfed Q – Sword Charge - Demonic Shard count from 6 to 3.

- Demonic Shards can now be picked up like regular items.

- Nerfed Damage Amplification stats of items.

3. Hit Feedback Improvements

- Added a red bloodstain effect around the camera when taking damage.

- When HP drops below 30%, a dark vignette appears to give the impression of a narrowing field of vision.

4. Skill Animations & Effects

- Added animation for Warrior R – Swordrain - Shockwave.

- Made Warrior E Armament (Sword) skill appear and disappear more smoothly.

notes.title: The Heretics Playtest 0.0.0.4 Patch Note (2025.04.29)
notes.content:
Patch Notes

1. Warrior's skills have been reworked.

2. A shop lock feature has been added.

3. An item storage system has been added. Items stored in the storage no longer affect the player's stats

notes.title: The Heretics Playtest 0.0.0.3 Patch Note (2025.04.24)
notes.content:
[b]Contents[/b]

- The Warrior character which used to have sword skills and shield skills is now separated to Warrior and Demon Knight. 
- Character choosing panel has been added, you can choose two characters so far.

notes.title: Hotfix - Minor Bugs
notes.content:
[b]Minor bug fix[/b]
1. Invisible obstacle in the middle of map in stage Mortal Lands and Heavn has been removed
2. Item description panel used to show wrong combination items.

notes.title: The Heretics Playtest 0.0.0.2 Patch Note (2025.04.19)
notes.content:
New
1. How to Play" tab has been added on the main menu
2. Game result screen now displays victory/defeat status and the final wave reached.
3. Now, it requires coins to reset skill points. Skill reset expense increase as you level up.

UX Improvement
1. Option and How to Play panels can now be closed using the ESC key. 
2. When item description panel is opened, it can be closed by clicking on background.

UI Improvement
1. Loading bar and enemy composition panel have been visually improved.
2. Fonts for the pause panel, option panel, and damage numbers have been changed.
3. Option panel and Pause panel background image updated. 
4. Item combination recipes are now displayed in the item description panel. 
5. Skill tree panel and skill description panel show how to reset skill point (mouse right click)

Bug Fix
1. When skill haste exceeded 100, all skill cooldowns were reduced to 1 second.
2. Fixed a bug where incorrect unit icons were shown in the Kill Score section of the result screen.
3. Fixed a bug where the Kill Score counted not only player kills but also enemies removed at the end of a wave. 
4. Fixed a bug where armor, magic armor, and hp stats are not updated properly when a player level up .
